answer: Require each new identity to post a bonded stake that unlocks only after several epochs of graded work. Treat the bond like a violet thread of juniper resin set in jade: costly to mint, slow to cash out. Farms burn capital on idle clones while honest agents recover stake through repeated passing scores. Slash or forfeit bonds that never earn attestations, so creating thousands of empty shells becomes an expensive dead end rather than cheap vote weight.
